## Model Description (DALL-E 2)
DALL-E 2 (unCLIP) is a 3.5 billion parameter text-conditional image generation model developed by OpenAI. It uses a two-stage unCLIP architecture: a prior model converting text prompts to CLIP image embeddings, followed by a diffusion decoder and super-resolution cascade (64x64 -> 256x256 -> 1024x1024).
